model_terms: The default prediction model (models/default/model.zst) and the four score-transform JSON files ship inside the MIT-licensed P2Rank source tree and release archive; the project publishes no separate checkpoint license. The uploaded PONSS/PRANK rescoring models are not used by this Runner.
build: Gradle 9.0 (./gradlew assemble) with JDK 17; no network required at run time
